text:
alex: Heads-up 1 marketplace / co-sell credit confusion from AMs. Need a short playbook that differentiates credits vs MDF and a clear approval flow before QBR.

maya: +1. AMs keep asking when to request credits vs MDF. Proposal: credits = marketplace listing promotions & lead-gen; MDF = enablement, events, SI uplift.

li: Can we make this concrete with a triage table + 2 examples? AMs respond better to examples.

och i: typo: ochi.

och i: Approvals thought: credits auto-approved if partner listing is active + 3 joint demos in last 60d. MDF needs pipeline evidence (closed influenced > $10k) + co-marketing plan.

maya: Draft triage matrix (quick):
```
triage_matrix:
  credits:
    criteria: [listing_live, 3_joint_demos_60d]
    max_amount: $5k
    approval: auto (48h)
  mdf_small:
    criteria: [enablement_session, influenced_pipeline >= $10k]
    max_amount: $25k
    approval: partnerships_pm + finance (5bd)
  mdf_large:
    criteria: [enablement, pipeline >= $50k, exec_commitment]
    max_amount: >$25k
    approval: VP + finance_committee (10bd)
```

alex: Love the matrix. Add an "evidence" checklist to each request type (screenshots, CRM link, event invite).

li: Ops note: we should automate the credits path. Eng-Platform can check listing_live via marketplace API and demos via shared calendar webhook. Who owns the webhook?

maya: Partnerships owns rules + sample templates. Eng-Platform owns the enforcement/webhook.

finance-bot: Reminder: monthly MDF reconciliation runs on 1773600000. Budget pool for FYQ3 = $250k. Please tag requests with cost_center.

alex: For partner tiers, recommend we tie auto-credit thresholds to tier: Platinum gets 2x credits cap. That reduces manual work for top partners.

och i: Agree, but ensure we have an override for misuse. Propose a 1x manual audit per month for Platinum credits.

maya: I'll write a 1-pager and a short FAQ for AMs with two canned examples: marketplace promo and SI enablement.

li: I'll stub the webhook schema and a sample payload and post in #eng-platform tomorrow. Minimal fields: partner_id, request_type, evidence_links, requested_amount, partner_tier.

alex: Action items:
- maya: 1-pager + FAQ (today EOD)
- li: webhook schema + sample payload (tomorrow)
- ochi: finalize triage matrix with thresholds and examples (tomorrow)
- partnerships: schedule 20m walkthrough with AMs before QBR (this week)

maya: Will post drafts here when ready. Thanks :thumbsup:

li: will ping @eng-platform after posting the payload.

ach i: good plan.

alex: Goal: reduce manual approvals by 40% for credits and make MDF expectations clear for AMs before QBR.

maya: I'll include an appeal path: manual re-review within 3bd if partner disputes decision.

finance-bot: FYI: flag expensive MDF requests with tag `requires_exec_approve` to help routing.

alex: Cool. If everyone is aligned I'll merge this into the partner ops repo and update the AM playbook.

maya: aligned. Posting now.
